settings.heading: Let us line up your routine.
settings.text: Answer questions about your skin, your climate and your daily stress, and we will sort a morning and evening plan by step.

settings.title: Cleanse
settings.text: Remove oil, sunscreen and the day, with a gel for oily skin or a milk for dry.

settings.title: Treat
settings.text: A serum with seaweed and hyaluronic acid targets dryness, texture or fine lines.

settings.title: Moisturize
settings.text: Seal in water with a cream matched to your skin type.

settings.title: Protect
settings.text: Finish mornings with a broad-spectrum mineral sunscreen.

settings.title: Mask weekly
settings.text: A treatment mask once or twice a week gives skin an extra reset.

settings.label: How is body care different from face care?
settings.text: Body skin is thicker and loses moisture faster, so body formulas lean on richer oils and butters, while face products use lighter textures and concentrated actives.

settings.label: Which products suit sensitive skin?
settings.text: Choose the fragrance-free versions of the milk cleanser, hyaluronic serum, barrier cream and body butter, and patch-test any new product first.

settings.label: How often should I exfoliate?
settings.text: Once or twice a week is enough for most people. Use the salt scrub on the body and the overnight resurfacing serum on the face, never on the same night.

settings.label: Are the formulas vegan and cruelty-free?
settings.text: Yes. Nothing contains animal ingredients and nothing is tested on animals at any stage.

settings.label: How do I choose by skin type?
settings.text: Oily and combination skin like gels and water creams, dry skin prefers milks and rich creams, and sensitive skin does best with fragrance-free formulas.
